outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the differentiation protocol, not a plot showing averaged data.
Panel B is a western blot image, not a quantitative plot of averaged data.
Panel C consists of line plots (mean ± SEM) over a time course. Line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points, as overlaying would make them unreadable.
Panel D shows live fluorescence micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel E consists of flow cytometry scatter plots, where individual cells are directly plotted as data points.
Panel F is a line plot showing mean ± SEM across conditions; line plots are exempt from the individual-points requirement.
Panel G is a line plot showing mean ± SEM across conditions; line plots are exempt from the individual-points requirement.
Panel H shows immunofluorescence micrographs of whole-mount EBs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel I displays Tukey boxplots, which already convey the data distribution and are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
Panel J is a hierarchical clustering heatmap; heatmaps are exempt since individual data points are not meaningful in this representation.
